SUPERSEDED_PREMISES.premise: the real within-class over pooled ratio is about 1
SUPERSEDED_PREMISES.corrected: the guard fails a candidate whose ratio collapses toward zero, and no recorded candidate did (lowest 0.9794). But the real ratio is 0.7435, not 1.0118: within-class dependence is about 74% of pooled, so part of the real pooled dependence is class separation. Every recorded synthetic range lies above the corrected real ratio. The inferences built on a ratio of about 1, that real dependence carries essentially no class separation and that a successor's states cannot simply be the broad cell classes, rested on the old input
